email_subject: Possible adverse event report - Demo-Glutide patient with a mild skin rash
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 52-year-old female patient with a history of type 1 diabetes received their first dose of Demo-Glutide (dose: 2 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-02-11.
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a mild skin rash.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Duval (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter651@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
